insight: Founded in Cambridge in 2006 by Tony Robinson, a 1980s pioneer of recurrent-neural-network speech recognition.
name: Speechmatics
tagline: Enterprise speech APIs — real-time STT, TTS, and voice agents.
description: Speechmatics provides speech-to-text (batch and sub-second real-time), text-to-speech, and a Flow API for building voice agents, with accuracy that holds up across accents and dialects in 55+ languages. The same engine deploys in cloud, container, on-prem, or fully on-device, and it powers products from Adobe, LiveKit, and Ubisoft.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary speech models; runs from cloud down to fully on-device.

edge: Stands out for accent and dialect robustness plus deployment flexibility — the same engine runs in cloud, container, on-prem, or fully on-device.
pros: STT, TTS, and voice agents in one API
Free tier (8 hrs of STT per month)
cons: TTS newer than its core STT
